title: Brushed Bronze Glass Shelf With Towel Bar, 16-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Rail & 3/8-In Tempered Glass, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Brushed Bronze, glass shelf with towel bar, 16-inch wall mount bathroom shelf with 3/8-in (0.38 in) tempered glass and solid brass hardware for organized storage and towel hanging, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms. Measures 16 in L x 5 in projection x 12 in H; supports up to 4 lb. Features a solid brass gallery rail to help keep items secure and concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look. Traditional style with transitional versatility for everyday bath storage of toiletries, soap, and accessories while adding a towel holder/towel bar below. Includes glass shelf and all installation hardware; assembly not required. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Allied Brass, Waverly Place collection.
